ITEM 1 | Dark green leafy greens (arugula-like, slender flat leaves with serrated edges and thin pale stems) spread across the left and center of the plate, slightly wilted, matte, lightly dressed with a faint sheen; covers roughly 30% of plate diameter area, about 3 cm tall in mounds | 45
ITEM 2 | Yellow-orange roasted squash pieces, irregular wedges about 3-4 cm long, 1 cm thick, with browned caramelized edges, soft and slightly glossy, some with darker charred patches; scattered over the greens in the center and upper right | 90
ITEM 3 | Dark green-black charred zucchini or courgette slices, rounded pieces about 2-3 cm across, 0.5 cm thick, with grill marks and blackened spots, moist and soft, interspersed with squash | 35
ITEM 4 | Bright green broccoli florets, one larger floret about 4 cm across at top right and one about 3 cm at right edge, plus a smaller floret cluster near center; firm, slightly glossy, with some darker tips | 40
ITEM 5 | Medium-rare sliced beef, dark reddish-brown crust on outside with pinkish-red interior, slices about 6-7 cm long, 1 cm thick, moist and juicy with visible fibers, sitting at lower right and bottom center of plate, with small browned bits | 110
ITEM 6 | Pale brown crumbly bits and small light-brown fragments near the bottom center beside the beef, possibly seasoning or toasted crumbs, dry and irregular, about 1-2 cm in scattered spots | 5
ITEM 7 | Glossy dark brown meat juices and light pan-residue sheen pooled around the beef slices, thin film on plate, slightly sticky | 8
